snippet.title: Heartreave | Turn-based hack-and-slash card game | Free demo on Steam
snippet.description:
Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5259350/Heartreave/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short

A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics and creature hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

Discord: https://discord.gg/pERJT9NgZA
Website: https://heartreave.com

#turnbased #cardgame #indiegame
